"""Modeles de l'app progress.

Perimetre : LessonProgress, CourseProgress, SkillMastery.

Points structurants (CLAUDE.md) : « lecon terminee » n'est PAS « skill
maitrise ». La completion est un fait binaire (LessonProgress) ; la maitrise est
un score evolutif (SkillMastery), et c'est elle qui ouvre les prerequis.

Surtout : la maitrise ne progresse QUE sur des exercices de PRODUCTION
(`exercises.Exercise.is_practice`). Les echauffements de rappel (types A/B/D) et
la transition (type C) n'y contribuent jamais - « la pratique prime ».
"""

from django.core.validators import MaxValueValidator, MinValueValidator
from django.db import models

from common.enums import CompletionStatus
from common.models import TimeStampedModel


class LessonProgress(TimeStampedModel):
    """Avancement d'un utilisateur sur une lecon."""

    user = models.ForeignKey(
        "users.User",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="lesson_progress",
        verbose_name="utilisateur",
    )
    lesson = models.ForeignKey(
        "learning.Lesson",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="progress_entries",
        verbose_name="lecon",
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        "statut",
        max_length=20,
        choices=CompletionStatus.choices,
        default=CompletionStatus.NOT_STARTED,
        db_index=True,
    )
    started_at = models.DateTimeField("commencee le", null=True, blank=True)
    completed_at = models.DateTimeField("terminee le", null=True, blank=True)
    last_viewed_at = models.DateTimeField("derniere consultation", null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "progression de lecon"
        verbose_name_plural = "progressions de lecons"
        ordering = ["-updated_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["user", "lesson"], name="lessonprogress_unique_user_lesson"
            )
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["user", "status"], name="lessonprogress_user_st_idx"),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.user} - {self.lesson} ({self.get_status_display()})"


class CourseProgress(TimeStampedModel):
    """Avancement d'un utilisateur sur un parcours complet.

    `completion_percent` est un CACHE recalculable a partir des
    `LessonProgress` du parcours ; il n'est ecrit que par la couche service.
    """

    user = models.ForeignKey(
        "users.User",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="course_progress",
        verbose_name="utilisateur",
    )
    learning_path = models.ForeignKey(
        "learning.LearningPath",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="progress_entries",
        verbose_name="parcours",
    )
    status = models.CharField(
        "statut",
        max_length=20,
        choices=CompletionStatus.choices,
        default=CompletionStatus.NOT_STARTED,
        db_index=True,
    )
    completion_percent = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(
        "avancement (%, cache)",
        default=0,
        validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)],
    )
    started_at = models.DateTimeField("commence le", null=True, blank=True)
    completed_at = models.DateTimeField("termine le", null=True, blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "progression de parcours"
        verbose_name_plural = "progressions de parcours"
        ordering = ["-updated_at"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["user", "learning_path"],
                name="courseprogress_unique_user_path",
            )
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.user} - {self.learning_path} ({self.completion_percent}%)"


class SkillMastery(TimeStampedModel):
    """Maitrise d'un skill par un utilisateur.

    `mastery_score` (0-100) est la mesure qui ouvre les prerequis. Il monte
    avec les reussites sur des exercices de PRODUCTION, redescend avec les
    echecs, et sa regle de calcul vit dans la couche service, jamais ici.
    Un QCM reussi ne le fait pas bouger : c'est la regle centrale du produit.
    """

    #: Seuil a partir duquel un skill est considere comme acquis.
    MASTERED_THRESHOLD = 70

    user = models.ForeignKey(
        "users.User",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="skill_masteries",
        verbose_name="utilisateur",
    )
    skill = models.ForeignKey(
        "learning.Skill",
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="masteries",
        verbose_name="skill",
    )
    mastery_score = models.PositiveSmallIntegerField(
        "score de maitrise",
        default=0,
        validators=[MinValueValidator(0), MaxValueValidator(100)],
    )
    attempts_count = models.PositiveIntegerField("tentatives", default=0)
    successes_count = models.PositiveIntegerField("reussites", default=0)
    last_practiced_at = models.DateTimeField(
        "derniere pratique", null=True, blank=True
    )

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = "maitrise de skill"
        verbose_name_plural = "maitrises de skills"
        ordering = ["-mastery_score", "skill"]
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["user", "skill"], name="skillmastery_unique_user_skill"
            )
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(
                fields=["user", "-mastery_score"], name="skillmastery_user_score_idx"
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.user} - {self.skill} : {self.mastery_score}"

    @property
    def is_mastered(self) -> bool:
        return self.mastery_score >= self.MASTERED_THRESHOLD
"""Progression des lecons, verrouillage par prerequis de Skills, parcours.

Une lecon est accessible si tous les Skills prerequis sont maitrises
(`SkillMastery.is_mastered`, seuil porte par le modele). Les prerequis sont
`Lesson.required_skills` plus les `Skill.prerequisites` des skills enseignes.
La maitrise ne vient que des exercices de production (A/B/D ne debloquent rien).
"""

from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from apps.learning.models import LearningPath, Lesson, Skill
from apps.progress.models import CourseProgress, LessonProgress, SkillMastery
from common.enums import CompletionStatus


class LessonLocked(Exception):
    """Lecon verrouillee ; `missing` liste les Skills a maitriser."""

    def __init__(self, missing):
        self.missing = list(missing)
        super().__init__("Lecon verrouillee.")


def required_skill_ids(lesson: Lesson) -> set[int]:
    taught = {s.id for s in lesson.skills_taught.all()}
    required = {s.id for s in lesson.required_skills.all()}
    required |= set(
        Skill.objects.filter(unlocks__in=taught).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )
    return required - taught


def mastered_skill_ids(user) -> set[int]:
    return {
        m.skill_id
        for m in SkillMastery.objects.filter(
            user=user, mastery_score__gte=SkillMastery.MASTERED_THRESHOLD
        )
    }


def missing_skills(user, lesson: Lesson, mastered: set[int] | None = None):
    needed = required_skill_ids(lesson)
    if not needed:
        return []
    mastered = mastered_skill_ids(user) if mastered is None else mastered
    return list(Skill.objects.filter(id__in=needed - mastered).order_by("name"))


def is_unlocked(user, lesson: Lesson) -> bool:
    return not missing_skills(user, lesson)


def _ensure_unlocked(user, lesson):
    missing = missing_skills(user, lesson)
    if missing:
        raise LessonLocked(missing)


@transaction.atomic
def start_lesson(user, lesson: Lesson) -> LessonProgress:
    _ensure_unlocked(user, lesson)
    now = timezone.now()
    lp, _ = LessonProgress.objects.get_or_create(user=user, lesson=lesson)
    lp.last_viewed_at = now
    if lp.status == CompletionStatus.NOT_STARTED:
        lp.status = CompletionStatus.IN_PROGRESS
        lp.started_at = now
    lp.save()
    recompute_course(user, lesson.module.learning_path)
    return lp


@transaction.atomic
def complete_lesson(user, lesson: Lesson) -> LessonProgress:
    _ensure_unlocked(user, lesson)
    now = timezone.now()
    lp, _ = LessonProgress.objects.get_or_create(user=user, lesson=lesson)
    lp.started_at = lp.started_at or now
    lp.last_viewed_at = now
    if lp.status != CompletionStatus.COMPLETED:
        lp.status = CompletionStatus.COMPLETED
        lp.completed_at = now
    lp.save()
    recompute_course(user, lesson.module.learning_path)
    return lp


def recompute_course(user, path: LearningPath) -> CourseProgress:
    """Recalcule le cache : part des lecons publiees du parcours terminees."""
    lesson_ids = list(
        Lesson.objects.filter(
            module__learning_path=path, module__is_published=True, is_published=True
        ).values_list("id", flat=True)
    )
    done = LessonProgress.objects.filter(
        user=user, lesson_id__in=lesson_ids, status=CompletionStatus.COMPLETED
    ).count()
    started = LessonProgress.objects.filter(
        user=user, lesson_id__in=lesson_ids
    ).exists()
    percent = round(100 * done / len(lesson_ids)) if lesson_ids else 0
    cp, _ = CourseProgress.objects.get_or_create(user=user, learning_path=path)
    now = timezone.now()
    cp.completion_percent = percent
    if lesson_ids and done == len(lesson_ids):
        cp.status = CompletionStatus.COMPLETED
        cp.completed_at = cp.completed_at or now
    elif started:
        cp.status = CompletionStatus.IN_PROGRESS
        cp.completed_at = None
    if started and not cp.started_at:
        cp.started_at = now
    cp.save()
    return cp


def progress_overview(user, paths) -> list[dict]:
    """Progression par parcours avec l'etat ouvert/verrouille de chaque lecon."""
    mastered = mastered_skill_ids(user)
    statuses = dict(
        LessonProgress.objects.filter(user=user).values_list("lesson_id", "status")
    )
    out = []
    for path in paths:
        cp = CourseProgress.objects.filter(user=user, learning_path=path).first()
        lessons = []
        qs = (
            Lesson.objects.filter(
                module__learning_path=path,
                module__is_published=True,
                is_published=True,
            )
            .select_related("module")
            .prefetch_related("skills_taught", "required_skills")
            .order_by("module__order", "order", "title")
        )
        for lesson in qs:
            missing = missing_skills(user, lesson, mastered)
            lessons.append(
                {
                    "id": lesson.id,
                    "title": lesson.title,
                    "status": statuses.get(lesson.id, CompletionStatus.NOT_STARTED),
                    "locked": bool(missing),
                    "missing_skills": [{"id": s.id, "name": s.name} for s in missing],
                }
            )
        out.append(
            {
                "learning_path": {"id": path.id, "slug": path.slug, "title": path.title},
                "status": cp.status if cp else CompletionStatus.NOT_STARTED,
                "completion_percent": cp.completion_percent if cp else 0,
                "lessons": lessons,
            }
        )
    return out
"""Vues de progression : valident, delèguent aux services."""

from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView

from apps.learning.services import catalog
from apps.progress.services import lessons as svc


class _LessonActionView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    action = None

    def post(self, request, pk):
        lesson = get_object_or_404(catalog.lessons_queryset(request.user), pk=pk)
        try:
            lp = getattr(svc, self.action)(request.user, lesson)
        except svc.LessonLocked as exc:
            return Response(
                {
                    "detail": "Leçon verrouillée.",
                    "locked": True,
                    "missing_skills": [
                        {"id": s.id, "name": s.name} for s in exc.missing
                    ],
                },
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )
        return Response(
            {
                "lesson": lesson.id,
                "status": lp.status,
                "started_at": lp.started_at,
                "completed_at": lp.completed_at,
            }
        )


class LessonStartView(_LessonActionView):
    action = "start_lesson"


class LessonCompleteView(_LessonActionView):
    action = "complete_lesson"


class ProgressView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        paths = catalog.paths_queryset(request.user)
        return Response({"results": svc.progress_overview(request.user, paths)})
from django.urls import path

"""Attribution d'XP via le ledger `XPTransaction` et calcul du niveau.

Le ledger est la source de verite ; `Profile.total_xp` et `Profile.level` ne
sont que des caches, mis a jour ici et nulle part ailleurs.
"""

from django.conf import settings
from django.db import IntegrityError, transaction
from django.db.models import Sum

from apps.exercises.enums import ExerciseType
from apps.gamification.models import XPSource, XPTransaction
from apps.users.models import Profile


def level_for_xp(total_xp: int) -> int:
    """Niveau atteint (>= 1) pour une XP cumulee, selon `XP_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS`."""
    reached = sum(1 for t in settings.XP_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS if total_xp >= t)
    return max(reached, 1)


def _refresh_cache(user) -> Profile:
    total = (
        XPTransaction.objects.filter(user=user).aggregate(s=Sum("amount"))["s"] or 0
    )
    total = max(total, 0)
    profile, _ = Profile.objects.select_for_update().get_or_create(user=user)
    profile.total_xp = total
    profile.level = level_for_xp(total)
    profile.save(update_fields=["total_xp", "level", "updated_at"])
    return profile


def recompute_user_cache(user) -> Profile:
    """Recalcule `total_xp` et `level` d'un utilisateur depuis le ledger."""
    with transaction.atomic():
        return _refresh_cache(user)


def award_exercise_xp(user, exercise) -> XPTransaction | None:
    """Credite l'XP de la premiere reussite ; renvoie None si deja attribuee."""
    source = (
        XPSource.CHALLENGE_SOLVED
        if exercise.type == ExerciseType.CHALLENGE
        else XPSource.EXERCISE_SOLVED
    )
    try:
        with transaction.atomic():
            tx, created = XPTransaction.objects.get_or_create(
                user=user,
                source=source,
                reference_key=f"exercise:{exercise.pk}",
                defaults={
                    "amount": exercise.effective_xp_reward,
                    "metadata": {"exercise_type": exercise.type},
                },
            )
            if not created:
                return None
            _refresh_cache(user)
            return tx
    except IntegrityError:
        return None

def _xp_block(user) -> dict:
    total = max(
        XPTransaction.objects.filter(user=user).aggregate(s=Sum("amount"))["s"] or 0, 0
    )
    level = level_for_xp(total)
    thresholds = settings.XP_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS
    # Le niveau N demarre au seuil d'indice N-1 ; le suivant, a l'indice N.
    next_threshold = thresholds[level] if level < len(thresholds) else None
    return {
        "total_xp": total,
        "level": level,
        "next_level_xp": next_threshold,
        "xp_to_next_level": None if next_threshold is None else next_threshold - total,
    }


def _next_lesson(user, path, mastered: set[int]):
    lessons = (
        Lesson.objects.filter(
            module__learning_path=path, module__is_published=True, is_published=True
        )
        .prefetch_related("skills_taught__prerequisites", "required_skills")
        .order_by("module__order", "order", "title")
    )
    done = set(
        LessonProgress.objects.filter(
            user=user, status=CompletionStatus.COMPLETED
        ).values_list("lesson_id", flat=True)
    )
    for lesson in lessons:
        if lesson.id in done:
            continue
        taught = {s.id for s in lesson.skills_taught.all()}
        needed = {s.id for s in lesson.required_skills.all()}
        for s in lesson.skills_taught.all():
            needed |= {p.id for p in s.prerequisites.all()}
        if not (needed - taught) - mastered:
            return {"id": lesson.id, "title": lesson.title}
    return None

        .select_related("learning_path")
        .order_by("-updated_at")
    )

+"""Donnees du tableau de bord etudiant : lecture seule, requetes regroupees.
+
+L'XP vient du ledger (`XPTransaction`), pas du cache `Profile.total_xp`.
+Aucune `solution` d'exercice n'est lue ni renvoyee.
+"""
+
+from django.conf import settings
+from django.db.models import Sum
+
+from apps.exercises.models import ExerciseAttempt
+from apps.gamification.models import XPTransaction
+from apps.gamification.services.xp import level_for_xp
+from apps.learning.models import Lesson
+from apps.progress.models import CourseProgress, LessonProgress, SkillMastery
+from common.enums import CompletionStatus
+
+RECENT_ATTEMPTS = 5
+
+
+def _xp_block(user) -> dict:
+    total = max(
+        XPTransaction.objects.filter(user=user).aggregate(s=Sum("amount"))["s"] or 0, 0
+    )
+    level = level_for_xp(total)
+    thresholds = settings.XP_LEVEL_THRESHOLDS
+    # Le niveau N demarre au seuil d'indice N-1 ; le suivant, a l'indice N.
+    next_threshold = thresholds[level] if level < len(thresholds) else None
+    return {
+        "total_xp": total,
+        "level": level,
+        "next_level_xp": next_threshold,
+        "xp_to_next_level": None if next_threshold is None else next_threshold - total,
+    }
+
+
+def _next_lesson(user, path, mastered: set[int]):
+    lessons = (
+        Lesson.objects.filter(
+            module__learning_path=path, module__is_published=True, is_published=True
+        )
+        .prefetch_related("skills_taught__prerequisites", "required_skills")
+        .order_by("module__order", "order", "title")
+    )
+    done = set(
+        LessonProgress.objects.filter(
+            user=user, status=CompletionStatus.COMPLETED
+        ).values_list("lesson_id", flat=True)
+    )
+    for lesson in lessons:
+        if lesson.id in done:
+            continue
+        taught = {s.id for s in lesson.skills_taught.all()}
+        needed = {s.id for s in lesson.required_skills.all()}
+        for s in lesson.skills_taught.all():
+            needed |= {p.id for p in s.prerequisites.all()}
+        if not (needed - taught) - mastered:
+            return {"id": lesson.id, "title": lesson.title}
+    return None
+
+
+def build_dashboard(user) -> dict:
+    masteries = list(SkillMastery.objects.filter(user=user).select_related("skill"))
+    mastered = {m.skill_id for m in masteries if m.is_mastered}
+
+    courses = list(
+        CourseProgress.objects.filter(user=user, status=CompletionStatus.IN_PROGRESS)
+        .select_related("learning_path")
+        .order_by("-updated_at")
+    )
+    next_lesson = _next_lesson(user, courses[0].learning_path, mastered) if courses else None
+
+    attempts = ExerciseAttempt.objects.filter(user=user).select_related("exercise")[
+        :RECENT_ATTEMPTS
+    ]
+    return {
+        **_xp_block(user),
+        "current_paths": [
+            {
+                "id": c.learning_path_id,
+                "slug": c.learning_path.slug,
+                "title": c.learning_path.title,
+                "completion_percent": c.completion_percent,
+            }
+            for c in courses
+        ],
+        "next_lesson": next_lesson,
+        "recent_attempts": [
+            {
+                "id": a.id,
+                "exercise": {
+                    "id": a.exercise_id,
+                    "title": a.exercise.title,
+                    "type": a.exercise.type,
+                },
+                "is_correct": a.is_correct,
+                "score": a.score,
+                "attempt_number": a.attempt_number,
+                "created_at": a.created_at,
+            }
+            for a in attempts
+        ],
+        "skills": [
+            {
+                "id": m.skill_id,
+                "name": m.skill.name,
+                "mastery_score": m.mastery_score,
+                "is_mastered": m.is_mastered,
+            }
+            for m in masteries
+        ],
+    }
